entities.name: Stig Sjölin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stig Karl Olof Sjölin was a Swedish middleweight boxer. He competed at the 1952 and 1956 Olympics and finished in third and ninth place, respectively. Between 1949 and 1955 he won four medals at European championships.
